description: The compiler directive that marks a file, Server Component, or async function as cacheable, storing its serialized return value in the Next.js cache.
The compiler mechanism that combines the deployment buildId, function hash, serialized arguments, and captured outer closure variables into a deterministic cache key.
The rule whereby uninspected JSX props such as children are passed as opaque references and omitted from the cache key hash, allowing cached wrappers to host dynamic children.
A three-part lifetime policy defining client cache reuse (stale), server background refresh threshold (revalidate), and hard eviction age (expire).
